_comment: MATLAB-produced reference metrics for the level-2 parity CI gate. Regenerate with code/python/tests/reference/runPhase5Metrics.m (see tests/reference/README.md). Recorded from MATLAB R2024b + RAVEN 2.11.2 on the committed yeast-GEM.xml of the source commit below. Both R2 values are the coefficient of determination about the line of identity over all data points, matching code/modelTests/{growth,anaerobic_flux_predictions}.m since 'fix: report CoD as R2 and not Pearson's r'.

tolerances._rationale: Solver drift around the 1e-6 growth-ratio threshold accounts for ~1-gene differences in the essential-gene confusion matrix and ~1e-3 differences in R^2 metrics. The reference is produced by MATLAB with Gurobi; CI resolves GLPK, because cobra only pulls in swiglpk and neither gurobipy nor highspy is installed there.
